newsitems.title: Patch 1.5
newsitems.author: Black Ivy (dev)
newsitems.contents: This patch fixes a residual error on our part. We left some of the debugging tools on with patch 1.4. We apologize for the mistake and hope you can play properly now!

newsitems.title: Patch 1.4
newsitems.author: Black Ivy (dev)
newsitems.contents:
This patch will fix the following bugs in the game:
- Possessed Agents would spawn more pistol ammo if you shoot their dead bodies.
- When using the motion camera, Agent Sigma (Player character) would clip through the camera when against the wall. 
- Agent Hope would not be able to take damage from the Flame Thrower shortly after the Player stopped and started shooting her with it. 

Hope these bug fixes help create a better experience when playing SCP: Abhorrent. Thank you so much for playing!

newsitems.title: Patch 1.3
newsitems.author: Black Ivy (dev)
newsitems.contents:
Please see patch details below:
-Buffed the Glock(Pistol) damage to give the player use of the weapon. 
-Fixed an issue where the flamer wasn't filling ammo at the same time as the audio cue on reload.

Known bug:
-Agent Hope(spider-like NPC) is having issues where she does not take flamer damage for a short time after returning from retreat sequence. Planning on fixing this very soon.

newsitems.title: Patch 1.2
newsitems.author: Black Ivy (dev)
newsitems.contents:
This patch is for minor bug fixes and a quality of life change.
-SCP Hybrid doesn't emit blood effect when shot after death. 
-SCP Hybrid doesn't continue movement animations after death.
-A brightness slider was added to the in game menu to in response to a valued players review (@NireIG). The brightness is meant to be dark, so the new slider goes just bright enough to help support darker monitors. We appreciate all feedback from the players in the reviews so far. Hope you enjoy the free game!

newsitems.title: Patch 1.1
newsitems.author: blackivy.dev
newsitems.contents:
Bug fixes:

- Removed "true" text being displayed on the left when fighting Possessed Agent.
- Fixed Ladder clipping through floor.
- Nerfed Possessed Agent Hope by slowing her ranged attach animation.
